items.title: Ernie Cagnolatti Interview, 1961-04-05
items.q: That's the Manetta still teaches. That's the same system? That's his system, too.

ctx.x: Slide it out and then out.

Now, some of the teachers... But that's the Manetta still teaches. That's the same system? That's his system, too. Now, some of the others, they'll give you one down, one out, one in, and one up on your comma time, four.
That's the way a Shalini taught you. One, two, three, four.
